record.body: This index lists the published sources behind the bioacoustic-recording-analysis pair, so that every method claim can be traced. The principal sources are the Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem, Pieretti and colleagues on the Acoustic Complexity Index, the soundscape-index literature on ADI and AEI, published evaluations of BirdNET and other classifiers, and the passive acoustic monitoring literature on ARUs and long-term monitoring. Where a figure is approximate, such as a frequency range that varies by species, the pair says so. Figures are given as of October 2026. This record is about methods and their sources, and it claims nothing beyond what those sources publish.
